description: This file contains functions and scripts related to platform-specific operations for firmware upgrade management, including image identification, validation, and updating procedures for devices using NAND and other storage formats. It handles firmware format detection, custom upgrade procedures, and interactions with external utilities like dd, hexdump, otrx, oseama, and osafeloader.

methods.name: get_magic_long_at
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a given offset and outputs as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: get_le_long_at
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a given offset and returns a little-endian integer.

methods.name: platform_flash_type
methods.description: Determines if the device flash type is serial or NAND based on /proc/mtd.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Returns the expected firmware image name for the current device model.

methods.name: platform_identify
methods.description: Identifies the firmware format and board ID by analyzing a firmware image.

methods.name: platform_other_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image against expectations and format.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Main function to check if the image is suitable for the current device.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nand_trx
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade procedures for NAND devices with TRX images.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nand_seamaseal
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade procedures for NAND devices with Seama seal images.

methods.name: platform_img_from_safeloader
methods.description: Extracts firmware image partitions from a safeloader container.

methods.name: platform_other_do_upgrade
methods.description: Determines the correct upgrade procedure depending on firmware format and type.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher based on device model.
